name: Potiphar's Wife
title: The Woman Who Falsely Accused Joseph
summary: Potiphar's wife repeatedly tried to seduce Joseph while he served in her husband's house. When he rejected her, she falsely accused him of assault, and Joseph was thrown into prison.

keyEvents.title: Falsely Accusing Joseph
keyEvents.description: When Joseph fled from her advances and left his cloak behind, she used it to falsely accuse him, and he was thrown into prison.
